evals.prompt: Create a dry-run plan for packaging USB installation files from an ICT image at /tmp/ubuntu-host.raw.gz. Select image-from-tool mode, use repository defaults, and do not run Docker, make, sudo, deployment, or network operations. Explain the checks and confirmation points that would occur.
evals.expected_output: Provide the selected mode, input validation, precondition checks, effective command, expected archive validation, optional VEN confirmation, and rollback guidance without claiming a build or deployment occurred.
expectations: Selects image-from-tool mode from the supplied .raw.gz path and does not ask to rebuild or reuse another image
Checks the repository, target files, Docker/buildx, make, proxy handling, ICT image extension/existence, and sudo requirement before privileged work
Builds the documented make command and expected output path without overwriting the ICT source template
Names all four required top-level archive entries and places the optional VEN deployment confirmation after packaging
Includes rollback guidance for packaged/intermediate output and any image created in the session
